git.note: CLI + range_server built from a87574a with --features remote (native default also on). Model served over a localhost HTTP Range server; staged through the implemented adapter; no fabricated transfer.

scope: Genuine end-to-end validation of the vendor-neutral remote staging pipeline: remote (localhost HTTP Range) -> bounded transfer -> whole-file SHA-256 verification -> atomic local publication -> authenticated Mode B inference, with output parity against direct-local Mode B. Also summarises the deterministic adversarial transport/staging test suite and regressions. HTTPS-to-public-internet and S3 are deferred (documented).

environment.filesystem: model + staging on ext4 (/home, /dev/sdc); repo on /mnt/e (NTFS via WSL)
environment.transport: std-only HTTP/1.1 Range adapter (crate feature `remote`); no TLS, no async runtime, no new dependencies

adapter.server: examples/range_server.rs (std-only loopback HTTP/1.1 Range file server)
adapter.comment: Loopback is permitted only via the explicit trusted-endpoint opt-in (--allow-private); the default policy rejects private/loopback/link-local targets (SSRF guard).

model.already_present: re-used the locally verified file from the prior session; not re-downloaded over the internet

staging_properties_verified.atomic_publication: rename within staging dir + directory fsync

inference.common: taskset -c 0,1 llmbridge chat <model> --prompt 'The capital of France is' --max-tokens 8 --ctx 128 --threads 2 --backend streamed --metrics --sha256 <sha> --address-space-mb 2048 --workspace-mb 48 --cache-mb 32 --snapshot-reuse

staged_mode_b.output: Paris. It is located in the northern

direct_local_mode_b.output: Paris. It is located in the northern

inference.output_parity: identical (bit-for-bit generated text, staged vs direct)
inference.interpretation: As expected (master spec §14), staging does not speed up local decode (staged and direct Mode B are within run-to-run noise). The benefit is paying the remote transfer once (18.55 s) rather than on every inference pass; decode remains the local out-of-core re-stream cost.

regressions.cpp_native_build: compiled as part of the release build (build.rs builds pinned llama.cpp/ggml)
regressions.windows_msvc_native: not exercised this session; validated on WSL2/Linux only

resource_limits.staging_disk_overhead: one whole-model .part during transfer (sparse pre-allocated), removed on publish
resource_limits.bounded_response_buffer: one chunk buffer per transfer; bounded header budget 64 KiB; no model-sized allocation

limitations: Public TLS/HTTPS not implemented: adapter accepts only the http scheme; a TLS-terminating proxy or a future feature is needed for public HTTPS. The genuine 7B experiment therefore used a localhost HTTP Range server, which exercises the full transport/staging/verify/publish/Mode-B contract deterministically.

S3-compatible adapter deferred: the RemoteSource trait is provider-neutral and ready for one, but no S3 adapter is implemented or validated (needs a maintained SDK and credentials/endpoint not deterministically testable). Not claimed as production-ready.
Windows MSVC native path not exercised this session.
Staging requires the whole model to fit on the staging filesystem; this is not unbounded model-size support and does not add remote computation.
classification: COMPLETE (evidence-backed) for: vendor-neutral RemoteSource contract, strict HTTP Range adapter, object-version binding, bounded resumable fail-closed local staging with atomic publication, Mode B integration, genuine localhost 7B staged inference with bit-identical parity to direct-local, adversarial transport/staging tests, and regressions. DEFERRED (documented): public TLS/HTTPS and the S3-compatible adapter.
